name: Komiya Chie
source:
One of the original participants.

She is a very shy woman who is interested in the occult. Despite her age, she still wears a sailor school uniform due to not having anything else to wear. Being a hikikomori, she much prefers to be alone and often comes off as strange.

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Chie_Komiya]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
